run_reencode_audio_cli: run the CLI tool to re-encode all WAV files in a directory to a new sample rate
load_wav_function: load a WAV audio file and optionally resample it to a target sample rate using resampy
save_wav_function: save an audio signal array to a WAV file with a specified sample rate
reencode_audio_function: re-encode a single WAV audio file to a new sample rate by loading and saving it
review_load_wav_resampling: review the load_wav function to understand how it handles mono signals and kaiser_best filter resampling
